Headline: #147 Outer Drive Express Temporary Southbound Reroute near Howard/Paulina
ShortDescription: SB 147 Outer Drive Express buses are temporarily rerouted via due to a street blockage near Howard/Paulina.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound #147 Outer Drive Express buses are temporarily rerouted via Howard Terminal, Howard, Clark, Rogers, Sheridan and over regular route, due to a street blockage near Howard/Paulina.

Northbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
